chunks: Humayd, from Ibn Sama'ah, from Ibn Rabat, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Al-Abbas, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'The woman whose husband has died from her [i.e., she is widowed].' He (peace be upon him) said: 'She should not apply kohl for adornment, nor perfume herself, nor wear dyed clothes, nor go out during the day, nor spend the night away from her house.' I said, 'What is your view if she wants to go out for a right [need], how should she do it?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'She should go out after midnight, and return by late evening.'
ai.seo_question: What are the rules for a widow's behavior and movement during her waiting period (Iddah) in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific behavioral constraints for a widow during her 'Iddah, emphasizing modesty by prohibiting kohl, perfume, and dyed garments to distinguish her from a bride. It further regulates her mobility, permitting daytime exits for valid needs but recommending nocturnal travel (after midnight) to minimize social interaction, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on preserving the widow's dignity and privacy.

en.hubeali: Humeyd, from Ibn Sama’at, from Ibn Rabat, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Al Abbas who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The woman widowed from her husband. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She should neither apply the Kohl for the adornment, nor perfume, nor wear coloured clothes, nor go out during the day, nor spend the night away from her house’. I said, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if she wanted to go out to a right, how should she do it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She should go out after midnight, and she should return by late evening’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Aban from ibn abu Ya‘fur who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman whose husband dies.

He (the Imam) said, ‘She must not use kohl for beautification or perfume and must not wear colorful dress, spend the night somewhere else. She can pay off rights, use hair clip and go for al-Hajj even though she is in her waiting period.’”
